assembly: STYLE_PREAMBLE + PERIOD + SCENE_KEY + PLANE_BRIEF + subject — blocks pasted verbatim from ../../brand/prompt-kit.md. The host is composited, not prompted.
notes: Vertical Short. Kouki is a Figma vector component, composited in the edit — never generated. Shots 1 and 12 generate as empty backgrounds with space reserved for her on the branch.

shots.subject: An empty olive branch crossing the lower third of frame, warm lamplit glow behind, soft rounded shapes suggesting a sheltered courtyard. Space clear on the branch, right of centre. No animals, no birds.
shots.motion: Slow push in. One slow blink. Branch drifts 2px.

narration.en: Everyone knows this one. Almost nobody remembers why it's good.
narration.gr: Την ξέρουν όλοι αυτή. Σχεδόν κανείς δεν θυμάται γιατί είναι καλή.

shots.subject: A hare mid-stride on a dusty track, built from simple circles and rounded rectangles, long ears swept back. Far plane: low bleached hills. Mid plane: an olive grove and a low rough stone wall. Foreground: a dry stone wall cropped by the bottom frame edge. Wide shot, hare off-centre left.
shots.motion: Horizontal pan following the hare. Dust shapes drift back.

shots.subject: Close shot of the same hare, chest out, chin lifted, eyes half-lidded with confidence. Flat bleached background with one hard blue shadow shape. Foreground: a single cropped olive branch top-right.

narration.gr: «Κανείς εδώ δεν τρέχει πιο γρήγορα από μένα.»

shots.subject: A tortoise seen from a low angle, calm and unimpressed, shell built from simple geometric segments. Cool green shade. Far plane: silhouetted tree mass. Foreground: grass blades cropped by the bottom edge. Subject centred low in frame.
shots.motion: Very slow push in. Head extends slightly.

narration.gr: Η χελώνα είπε: «Θες να το δούμε;»

shots.subject: A small crowd of simple flat animal shapes laughing — a goat, two birds, a donkey — all leaning back. The tortoise small and completely still among them. Bleached light, an olive grove behind. Foreground: cropped grasses along the bottom edge.
shots.motion: Crowd shapes bob. The tortoise does not move at all.

shots.subject: A start line marked in the dust. The hare exploding forward, body stretched, dust bursting behind him. The tortoise one step behind, mid-step, unhurried. Wide shot. Foreground: dust shapes cropped by the bottom edge.
shots.motion: Fast whip pan left to right, settling.

shots.subject: Extremely wide shot. The hare tiny and far away near the top of frame, an empty pale road curving back toward the viewer, nothing else on it. Far plane: flat hills. Foreground: a cropped cypress silhouette at the left edge.
shots.motion: Slow pull back, emphasising the empty road.

narration.en: He was so far ahead he couldn't see her any more.
narration.gr: Είχε φύγει τόσο μπροστά που δεν την έβλεπε πια.

shots.subject: The hare asleep on his back beneath a broad olive tree, one long ear flopped over his eyes, paws loose. Cool flat shade. Far plane: low hills. Mid plane: a dry stone wall. Foreground: olive branches cropped by the top-left frame edge. Wide shot, subject off-centre right.
shots.motion: Gentle chest rise and fall. Leaf shapes drift.

narration.en: "I could sleep and still win." So he did.
narration.gr: «Μπορώ και να κοιμηθώ και πάλι θα κερδίσω.» Και κοιμήθηκε.

shots.subject: The tortoise walking steadily past the sleeping hare in the mid ground, facing forward, not looking at him. The hare small and asleep behind her. Foreground: tall grass shapes cropped by the bottom and right frame edges, partially occluding her.
shots.motion: Slow lateral track with the tortoise. Foreground grass parallaxes fast.

narration.en: She walked past him. She didn't stop to look.
narration.gr: Πέρασε δίπλα του. Δεν σταμάτησε να κοιτάξει.

shots.subject: The hare suddenly upright, eyes wide, ears straight up, mid-scramble, dust bursting under him. Harsh bleached light, one hard blue shadow. Foreground: cropped grass at the bottom edge.
shots.motion: Sharp snap zoom in, then hold.

shots.subject: A finish line marked by a scratch in the dust beside an olive tree. The tortoise already there, small and still, warm light. A few simple flat animal shapes around her, quiet rather than cheering. Foreground: cropped grasses across the lower frame.
shots.motion: Hold, almost static. Two seconds of no narration at the end.

shots.subject: An empty olive branch crossing the lower third of frame, warm evening light, quiet open ground beyond. Space clear on the branch, left of centre. No animals, no birds.
shots.motion: Very slow pull back. Head turns a few degrees on the final line, then stillness.

narration.en: The hare was faster. He was right about that. So — what did he get wrong?
narration.gr: Ο λαγός ήταν πιο γρήγορος. Σ' αυτό είχε δίκιο. Λοιπόν — σε τι έκανε λάθος;
